text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув didn't show up for training,
so I go
looking for her inside the
academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Recall the formula we went
over? Try
using it here.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Right... So I apply that like this, and...
Omigosh! I
did it!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Really, this is fairly standard. Maybe you
should
devote a little more time to your
studies...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But you should be fine for the test
tomorrow. Do
your best, okay?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I will! Thank you so much!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Today's training... Ngh, how could I
forget?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I take full responsibility,
and I'll
make sure it doesn't happen
again.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
